document.about: SEC filing, Exhibit 21: a list of subsidiaries set in tables, every row one cell across. Each country is bold and underlined over its companies in plain type, a blank row after each group.

notes: The filing parts the list into several tables at its page breaks. A group carried on into the next table has no band over it there: the first companies of the second table carry no country.

checks.issue: Every row of one cell was read as a band, the companies as well as the countries. A company was in no cell, and a blank row carried every name above it as its section label, up to 21 names and 604 characters.
As above, for the largest group.
As above, for a country with one company.
